name: testing
description: Test-stage discipline: /testing:plan (coverage gaps, test plans), /testing:write (TDD authoring), /testing:run-e2e (live E2E and smoke checks), /testing:diagnose (failing-test root cause, with a fix-until-green workflow across files), /testing:audit (can't-fail test audit with a fail-closed gate), /testing:cleanup (rewrite, quarantine, or delete low-value tests behind a mutation gate), /testing:setup, and an opt-in hook that flags edits that weaken tests.

test_guards_enabled.title: Test guard hooks
test_guards_enabled.description: Adds an advisory note when an edit removes tests or assertions, adds a skip or changes an expected value, and, only with rules test-weaken-block: error, denies an added skip or removed test block that adds no test-change: marker; it never asks, and is off by default.

e2e_driver.title: E2E driver
e2e_driver.description: Who drives when /testing:run-e2e drives the app itself, not through /app-control:drive: auto (default) picks the repo's harness when a spec covers the flow, else run or playwright; harness, run, playwright, or chrome (attended only). docs/conventions/testing.yaml wins.

reuse_running_instance.title: Reuse a running app
reuse_running_instance.description: When run-e2e drives the app itself, not through /app-control:drive: true, or auto (default) when attended, reuses an app that already answers. With a Workspace environment entry, false and unattended auto start their own instance; without, unattended auto reuses and false stops. testing.yaml wins.

browser_driver.title: Browser tool
browser_driver.description: The browser tool command (letters, digits, . _ -) a /testing:run-e2e playwright drive uses when run-e2e drives the app itself, not through /app-control:drive. Default playwright-cli. Missing from PATH, the run stops naming this setting; it never switches tools. testing.yaml wins.

pixel_tolerance.title: Visual parity pixel tolerance
pixel_tolerance.description: Differing pixels per image /testing:check-visual-parity accepts. It can only lower the repository's pixel_tolerance in docs/conventions/testing.yaml, never raise it. 0 by default.

stdin_read_timeout.title: Hook stdin read timeout (seconds)
stdin_read_timeout.description: Idle bound on reading the hook payload from stdin: how long the pipe may go silent before the hook gives up and fails open
